sprint.title: Derived Player-Safe Contextual Action Projection

Existing investigation and clue-presentation eligibility rules are reused without creating a second resolver or generic action framework.
Projection derivation is non-mutating and nonpersistent, reconstructs after save/load, and save version remains 1.
Stale displayed opportunities remain independently validated by existing deterministic resolvers and next_sprint remains null.

focused_commands: Affected movement, conversation, investigation, discovery, clue presentation, narration, and save/load regressions

No parser, declaration, schema, provider, save-version, generic-action, or generic-affordance expansion is authorized.
Save version remains 1 and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: Focused contextual-action coverage, affected regressions, and the complete local deterministic suite passed. No live provider request occurred.
